This Review synthesizes current understanding of gut microbiome dysregulation following solid organ transplantation, with particular emphasis on heart transplantation, examining mechanistic links underpinning important complications including allograft rejection, infection, metabolic dysfunction, and cardiac allograft vasculopathy. We critically evaluate bidirectional interactions between the gut microbiome and immunosuppressive drugs, assess the potential for microbiome profiling to serve as a predictive biomarker for post-transplant complications, and examine microbiome-targeted interventions including dietary modification, prebiotics, probiotics, and fecal microbiota transplant. Finally, we propose a translational roadmap to integrate microbiome science into heart transplant care to optimize immunosuppression, predict complications, and improve long-term outcomes for heart transplant recipients.
authors: Ðuran I, Tang WHW, Mamic P.
screening_reason: The review centrally focuses on the gut microbiome and its mechanistic role in host immunity, metabolism, and heart transplantation outcomes.
summary_ja: 心臓移植をはじめとする同種臓器移植後における腸内細菌叢の異常と、拒絶反応や感染症などの各種合併症との関連についてまとめた総説である。腸内細菌叢の乱れが宿主の免疫、代謝、炎症系を介して同種移植片血管病変などに影響するメカニズムを概説している。さらに、免疫抑制剤と細菌叢の双方向の相互作用や予測バイオマーカーとしての可能性、食事やプロバイオティクスなどの介入法について評価を行っている。最終的に、細菌叢研究を心移植医療に統合し長期予後を改善するための臨床応用へのロードマップを提示している。
summary_en: This review synthesizes current evidence on gut microbiome dysregulation following solid organ transplantation, focusing particularly on heart transplantation outcomes. It examines mechanistic links between microbial disruption and post-transplant complications such as allograft rejection, infection, and vasculopathy. The authors evaluate interactions between the microbiome and immunosuppressants, discuss biomarker potential, and propose a translational roadmap for microbiome-targeted therapies.
key_finding_ja: 心臓移植後の腸内細菌叢異常は、宿主の免疫や代謝を介して拒絶反応や感染症などの合併症に影響を及ぼす。
why_it_matters_ja: 腸内細菌叢の解析や標的介入を移植医療に応用することで、免疫抑制の最適化や長期的な予後改善につながる可能性がある。

title: Secreted nuclease effector neutralization by active site mimicry in Bacillota.
abstract: Polymorphic toxins mediate interbacterial antagonism among competitors in the gut microbiome. Nuclease effectors, distantly related to the type VI-secreted Bacteroidales Tde, are enriched in human gut Bacillota. Tde mediates antagonism among Bacillota, and expression of the cognate immunity, Tdi, in recipients is protective. Crystal structures of Tde/Tdi complexes from two Bacillus spp. and Enterococcus quebecensis highlight a conserved mechanism of immunity. Tdi engages Tde with high-affinity, specific binding at an interface that features predominantly polar amino acids. A separate Tdi interface has a very highly conserved P(Φ) 4 GG motif that structurally mimics and displaces a short helix in Tde's active site, which contains the critical catalytic residues. An isolated P(Φ) 4 GG motif peptide is sufficient for Tde nuclease activity inhibition at high concentrations. However, key residues at both the polar interface and P(Φ) 4 GG are required for complete inhibition of nuclease activity and protection against toxicity. We propose a multivalent Tde/Tdi neutralization mechanism where an initial high-affinity interface increases the local concentration of Tdi's P(Φ) 4 GG motif, enabling it to displace the Tde active site through structural mimicry. The resulting conformational rearrangement of Tde increases its flexibility in solution and susceptibility to proteolysis, which may aid in eliminating the toxic effector.IMPORTANCEBacteria in the gut microbiome compete using toxin secretion systems. Prior research has emphasized the importance of secretion systems in gram-negative bacteria. We describe a class of secreted nuclease effectors (toxins) and protective immunity proteins that are enriched in gram-positive Bacillota in human gut microbiomes. These effector/immunity pairs mediate antagonism among Bacillus and Enterococcus spp. The immunity proteins neutralize the nuclease effector through a unique mechanism of enzymatic active site mimicry. The immunity proteins bind effectors with very high-affinity at an interface with polar residues. The effector undergoes a large conformational change. A very highly conserved motif on the immunity surface competitively displaces an active site short helix and loop that contains the key catalytic residues. This rearrangement of the effector renders it inactive and susceptible to elimination by proteolysis.
authors: Abbasian R, Parajuli B, Yu L, Durocher B, Gardner E, Chodur E, Dwelley MK, Ellermeier CD, Ho TD, Bosch DE.
screening_reason: Mechanistic study of polymorphic nuclease toxins and immunity proteins mediating interbacterial antagonism within the gut microbiome.
summary_ja: 腸内細菌叢のBacillota門細菌に見られる多型毒素エフェクター（Tde）と免疫タンパク質（Tdi）の相互作用による細菌間拮抗作用の分子機構を解析した。X線結晶構造解析により、Tdiは高親和性の界面でTdeと結合し、保存されたP(Φ)4GGモチーフを用いてTdeの活性部位の短ヘリックスを構造的に模倣・置換することが明らかになった。この構造変化によりエフェクターが不活性化し、プロテアーゼ分解を受けやすくなることが示された。
summary_en: This study resolved the structural basis by which the immunity protein Tdi neutralizes the secreted nuclease effector Tde in gut Bacillota species. Crystal structures demonstrated that Tdi binds Tde with high affinity via a polar interface and utilizes a conserved P(Phi)4GG motif to structurally mimic and displace an active-site helix in Tde. This active site displacement leads to conformational destabilization, effector inactivation, and enhanced susceptibility to proteolytic degradation.
key_finding_ja: Bacillota門細菌の免疫タンパク質Tdiは、酵素活性部位の構造模倣という特異的な機序を介して毒素Tdeを中和・不活性化する。
why_it_matters_ja: 腸内細菌間での競合と共生の分子基盤を明らかにする研究であり、細菌叢の生態系制御や抗菌技術開発の基盤となる可能性がある。

title: Prebiotic raffinose attenuates surgery-induced delirium-like behaviors through gut microbiota-mediated serotonergic signaling in frail senescence-accelerated mice: an experimental study using SAMP10 mice.
abstract: Background Postoperative delirium (POD) is a severe neuropsychiatric complication characterized by acute cognitive dysfunction and neuroinflammation, particularly prevalent in frail elderly patients. While the gut-brain axis is recognized as a regulator of neuroinflammation, specific preventive strategies remain limited. We investigated whether preoperative administration of raffinose, a prebiotic trisaccharide, prevents POD-like behaviors through gut microbiota-mediated neuroimmune modulation in frail senescence-accelerated mice. Methods Twenty-six-week-old senescence-accelerated mice (SAMP10) were randomly assigned to control (N), surgery (O), or raffinose-treated surgery (R) groups (n = 5-6 per group, depending on the endpoint). Raffinose (5% w/v) was administered via drinking water for 4 weeks prior to laparotomy under general anesthesia. Delirium-like behaviors were assessed using the open field, Y-maze, and buried food tests at 6 h post-surgery. Serum biomarkers were quantified via ELISA. Gut microbiota composition was analyzed using 16S rRNA sequencing. Results Surgery was associated with a numerical reduction in Y-maze spontaneous alternation that showed a large effect size but did not reach conventional statistical significance (O: 4.32 ± 3.46% vs. N: 10.71 ± 5.41%; p = 0.097, Cohen's d = 1.41, 95% CI -0.04 to 2.79), whereas a robust and statistically significant motivational deficit was observed in the Buried Food Test (O: 240.8 ± 116.7 s vs. N: 35.2 ± 25.6 s; p = 0.001, d = 2.52). Raffinose pretreatment was associated with higher Y-maze spontaneous alternation compared with the surgery group (R: 12.4 ± 4.20%; p = 0.034 vs. O, d = 2.10) and with restoration of motivational behavior in the BFT (R: 18.7 ± 4.74 s; p = 0.0006 vs. O, d = 2.77). Systemically, raffinose reduced circulating IL-6 by 56% and preserved gut microbial α- and β-diversity, with significant enrichment of Lactobacillus. Lactobacillus abundance was strongly correlated with preserved serum serotonin (r = 0.72, p = 0.003). Conclusions Prebiotic raffinose attenuates surgery-induced systemic inflammation and preserves cognitive-attentional and motivational performance in frail mice, providing convergent behavioral, biochemical, and microbiome evidence consistent with a gut-microbiota-serotonergic mechanism, which requires direct causal validation in future studies. These findings provide a preclinical rationale for prehabilitation nutritional strategies targeting the gut-brain axis, while acknowledging that individual behavioral readouts differ in the strength of the surgery-induced control-vs-surgery contrast.
authors: Nishihara N, Tachibana S, Yamakage M.
screening_reason: Examines gut microbiota-mediated serotonergic signaling and neuroinflammation prevention in postoperative delirium.
summary_ja: 高齢老化促進マウス（SAMP10）を用いて、手術後せん妄様行動に対するプレバイオティクスであるラフィノースの予防的効果を評価した。開腹手術前にラフィノースを投与した結果、術後のY迷路課題および埋没エサ探しテストにおける行動障害が改善し、血清IL-6濃度が低下した。さらに、腸内細菌叢のα・β多様性が維持されLactobacillus属が増加し、その菌数が血清セロトニン濃度と正の相関を示した。
summary_en: This study evaluated whether preoperative administration of prebiotic raffinose attenuates surgery-induced delirium-like behaviors in frail SAMP10 mice. Raffinose pretreatment significantly improved behavioral performance in the Y-maze and buried food tests following laparotomy while suppressing serum IL-6 levels. The intervention preserved gut microbial diversity, enriched Lactobacillus abundance, and demonstrated a positive correlation between Lactobacillus levels and preserved serum serotonin.
key_finding_ja: プレバイオティクスであるラフィノースの事前投与は、腸内細菌叢の維持とセロトニン系を介して術後の全身性炎症およびせん妄様行動を緩和した。
why_it_matters_ja: 周術期における腸脳相関を標的とした栄養的介入の可能性をマウスモデルで示したものであり、ヒトへの臨床応用には直接的な因果関係の証明が必要である。

title: Porcine coronavirus promotes NLRP3 inflammasome activation during virus-induced neuroinflammation.
abstract: Neurotropic coronaviruses can invade the central nervous system (CNS) and cause severe neurological disease, but the mechanisms underlying virus-induced neuroinflammation remain incompletely understood. Here, we report that infection with porcine hemagglutinating encephalomyelitis virus (PHEV), a neurotropic betacoronavirus, is associated with mitochondrial dysfunction, including increased reactive oxygen species (ROS) production and loss of the mitochondrial membrane potential (ΔΨm). Our data identify the NOD-like receptor family pyrin domain-containing 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome as an important component connecting PHEV infection, mitochondrial stress, and PANoptosis. The viral nucleocapsid (N) protein interacted with the pyrin domain (PYD) of NLRP3 through its C-terminal region and facilitated inflammasome assembly without detectably disrupting the NLRP3-NIMA-related kinase 7 (NEK7) interaction. Pharmacological inhibition of NLRP3 or caspase-1, as well as genetic knockout of NLRP3, significantly reduced viral load, attenuated neuroinflammation, and delayed disease progression in PHEV-infected mice. Moreover, NLRP3 deficiency shifted the cell-death modality from PANoptosis to necroptosis, thereby mitigating CNS immunopathology. Together, these findings demonstrate that PHEV hijacks the NLRP3-mitochondrial axis to exacerbate neuroinflammatory injury and support further evaluation of inflammasome- and PANoptosis-related pathways as therapeutic targets for neurotropic coronavirus infections.IMPORTANCEPorcine hemagglutinating encephalomyelitis virus (PHEV) is a neurotropic betacoronavirus that primarily invades the central nervous system (CNS) and induces fatal encephalomyelitis in young piglets. However, the host and viral determinants that contribute to PHEV-induced brain injury remain incompletely defined. In this paper, we show that PHEV infection activates the host NOD-like receptor family pyrin domain-containing 3 (NLRP3) inflammatory pathway and that this response contributes to CNS immunopathology. Loss of NLRP3 shifts the infection-associated cell death program from PANoptosis to necroptosis. Blocking this pathway reduces viral load, attenuates neuroinflammation, and improves survival in infected mice. These findings expand our understanding of host responses to neuroinvasive coronaviruses and highlight inflammasome signaling as a candidate therapeutic target for controlling coronavirus-associated encephalitis in swine.
authors: Zhou Q, Shi J, Qiu R, Dai R, Lan Y, Zhou J, Deng X, He W, Li Z.
screening_reason: Investigates the molecular mechanisms of viral-induced neuroinflammation and NLRP3 inflammasome activation in the central nervous system.
summary_ja: 豚血球凝集性脳脊髄炎ウイルス（PHEV）感染による中枢神経系の炎症メカニズムにおけるNLRP3インフラマソームの役割を調査した。PHEV感染はミトコンドリア機能障害を引き起こし、ウイルスのNタンパク質がNLRP3のPYDドメインに結合することでインフラマソームの形成を促進した。NLRP3の阻害または欠損により、ウイルス量が減少し、神経炎症の抑制および感染マウスの生存期間延長が確認された。
summary_en: This study explored how porcine hemagglutinating encephalomyelitis virus (PHEV) triggers neuroinflammation via the NLRP3 inflammasome pathway. PHEV infection induced mitochondrial stress, and the viral N protein bound the PYD domain of NLRP3 to facilitate inflammasome assembly. Pharmacological inhibition or genetic deletion of NLRP3 reduced viral load, attenuated neuroinflammation, shifted the cell-death program from PANoptosis to necroptosis, and delayed disease progression in mice.
key_finding_ja: PHEVはNタンパク質を介してNLRP3インフラマソームを活性化し、PANoptosisを誘発して中枢神経系の免疫病理を増悪させる。
why_it_matters_ja: 豚コロナウイルス感染モデルにおける分子機序の解明であり、ウイルス性脳炎におけるインフラマソームを標的とした治療戦略の有用性を示唆している。

title: Gut microbiota transmits osteoimmune dysregulation and exacerbates trabecular bone loss in tristetraprolin-deficient mice.
abstract: Introduction Tristetraprolin (TTP) is an RNA-binding protein essential for controlling cytokine production, and its deficiency leads to profound skeletal deterioration. Although TTP deficiency is associated with systemic inflammation and microbial dysbiosis, the contribution of the gut microbiota to bone pathology remains poorly defined. Materials and methods We investigated whether the microbiome causally modulates osteoimmune mechanisms and bone microarchitecture in TTP-deficient mice. To isolate the effects of the microbiome, we utilized specific pathogen-free (SPF) and germ-free (GF) co-housing mouse models. Results Microbial transfer bidirectionally regulated systemic inflammation and the expansion of monocytic myeloid-derived suppressor cells (M-MDSCs), a population with potent osteoclastogenic capacity. Importantly, microbiota transfer was sufficient to induce osteoclast activation and a selective deterioration of trabecular bone microarchitecture in otherwise healthy mice, without affecting overall bone mass. Crucially, the transmission of these osteoimmune and skeletal phenotypes was microbiota-dependent; while a baseline genetic bone deficit persisted in GF TTP-deficient mice, the co-housing-induced M-MDSC expansion and trabecular bone alterations were not observed under GF conditions. Conclusion Our findings identify a microbiota-dependent osteoimmune axis that amplifies inflammatory bone loss in TTP deficiency. This work establishes the gut microbiome as a mechanistic modifier of bone quality in genetically driven inflammatory disease and highlights microbial targeting as a potential therapeutic strategy for inflammatory bone loss.
authors: Kwack KH, Sohn J, Zhang L, Li L, Mullaney R, Arao Y, Blackshear PJ, Kirkwood KL.
journal: Journal of bone and mineral metabolism
screening_reason: Demonstrates how the gut microbiome modulates osteoimmune mechanisms and inflammatory bone loss.
summary_ja: トリステトラプロリン（TTP）欠損マウスにおける骨病変に対する腸内細菌叢の影響を、無菌および特定病原体未感染マウスの同居モデルを用いて評価した。細菌叢の伝播は全身性炎症と単球系骨髄由来免疫抑制細胞（M-MDSC）の増加を誘導し、健常マウスにおいても破骨細胞の活性化と海綿骨微細構造の低下を引き起こした。無菌環境下では、同居によるM-MDSCの増加や海綿骨の変化は観察されなかった。
summary_en: This study investigated whether the gut microbiota modulates bone loss and osteoimmune mechanisms in tristetraprolin (TTP)-deficient mice using germ-free and specific pathogen-free co-housing models. Transfer of the microbiota promoted systemic inflammation and expanded osteoclastogenic M-MDSCs, impairing trabecular bone microarchitecture in healthy recipient mice. Under germ-free conditions, co-housing failed to induce M-MDSC expansion or trabecular bone deterioration, indicating that this osteoimmune pathway is microbiota-dependent.
key_finding_ja: 腸内細菌叢の伝播はM-MDSCの増加と破骨細胞の活性化を介して、TTP欠損に伴う海綿骨の低下を増幅させることが示された。
why_it_matters_ja: 遺伝的背景に伴う骨減少症における腸内細菌叢の修飾作用を示した実験結果であり、ヒトの骨炎症性疾患への応用可能性には慎重な検証が求められる。

title: Diroximel fumarate confers neuroprotection via reduced Th1 responses and induction of the anti-oxidative Nrf2 pathway in experimental neuroinflammation.
abstract: Inflammation and oxidative stress contribute significantly to tissue damage in multiple sclerosis. Fumaric acid esters such as Dimethyl fumarate and Diroximel fumarate (DRF) exhibit immunomodulatory and antioxidative properties, although their mechanisms remain incompletely understood. This study investigated the immunomodulatory and antioxidative mechanisms of fumaric acid esters, with a focus on DRF and its ability to confer neuroprotection in autoimmune neuroinflammation. The MOG-experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE) mouse model was employed and DRF was administered orally. In addition to clinical scoring of EAE severity, histological analyses were performed to assess inflammatory infiltration, demyelination, and axonal density. Immune responses were examined via immunophenotyping and cytokine measurements, and mRNA expression was analyzed to evaluate Nrf2 pathway activation. DRF treatment markedly ameliorated clinical EAE severity, reduced spinal cord infiltration of T cells-particularly Th1 cells-and promoted myelin and axonal preservation. Peripheral immune cells from DRF-treated mice produced lower levels of IFN-γ and IL-17A, while Nrf2-dependent antioxidative genes were upregulated in CNS tissue. Our results demonstrate neuroprotective, immunomodulatory, and antioxidative effects of DRF, supporting its role as beneficial modulator in neuroinflammation.
authors: Freudenstein D, Schneeweiss A, Krenz A, Gold R, Linker R, Haase S.
screening_reason: Focuses on immunomodulation and neuroprotective pathways in an experimental model of autoimmune neuroinflammation.
summary_ja: ジロキシメルフルマレート（DRF）の自己免疫性脳脊髄炎（EAE）マウスモデルにおける神経保護および抗酸化作用を検証した研究である。DRFの経口投与により、EAEの臨床的重症度が軽減し、脊髄へのT細胞およびTh1細胞の浸潤が抑制されるとともに、髄鞘と軸索の構造が保持された。また、末梢免疫細胞におけるIFN-γおよびIL-17Aの産生が低下し、中枢神経系組織でNrf2依存的な抗酸化遺伝子の発現が亢進した。
summary_en: This study evaluated the immunomodulatory and neuroprotective effects of diroximel fumarate (DRF) in a mouse model of experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis. Oral administration of DRF significantly reduced clinical disease severity, suppressed T-cell and Th1-cell infiltration into the spinal cord, and preserved myelin and axonal integrity. Furthermore, DRF attenuated peripheral IFN-gamma and IL-17A production while upregulating Nrf2-dependent antioxidative gene expression in the central nervous system.
key_finding_ja: DRFの投与は、Th1免疫応答の抑制と中枢神経系におけるNrf2経路の活性化を介して、EAEマウスの神経炎症と脱髄を軽減させる。
why_it_matters_ja: 本研究はマウスモデルに基づく成果であり、多発性硬化症に対する新たな治療メカニズムの理解に寄与するが、ヒトでの臨床効果についてはさらなる検討が必要である。

title: YY1 lactylation mediates epithelial barrier dysfunction during acute lung injury.
abstract: Elevated lactate levels in lung tissue are a distinct hallmark of acute lung injury (ALI), but the biological functions of glycolytic reprogramming and lactate-derived protein modification in damaged alveolar epithelial cells remain poorly elucidated. In the present study, we validated markedly increased lactate abundance in peripheral samples and lung tissues of multiple ARDS patients and multiple ALI mouse models. Administration of glycolysis inhibitor 2-DG to deplete endogenous lactate effectively mitigated lung injury and alveolar epithelial barrier dysfunction, whereas exogenous lactate supplementation significantly worsened these pathological manifestations. Genetic silencing of pulmonary LDHA via intratracheal injection of AAV9-shLdha successfully reproduced the protective phenotypes conferred by 2-DG treatment. Mechanistically, accumulated lactate facilitated Tip60-dependent lactylation modification of YY1 at lysine 183. Biochemical assays confirmed that YY1 K183 lactylation inhibited the expression of PGC-1α at transcriptional level, further causing mitochondrial homeostasis disorder and destruction of alveolar epithelial barrier. In vivo rescue experiments using lactylation-deficient YY1-K183R mutant verified the essential pathogenic role of this site-specific lactylation in LPS-triggered ALI progression. Additionally, we established two feasible translational therapeutic strategies, including K183-targeted cell-penetrating peptide and glycyrrhizin screened from compound libraries. Both candidates efficiently suppressed YY1 K183 lactylation, restored PGC-1α expression and mitochondrial function, and relieved pulmonary edema, inflammatory infiltration and cell apoptosis. In summary, lactate-driven YY1 K183 lactylation disrupts PGC-1α-mediated mitochondrial quality control and epithelial barrier stability. Intervening this lactate-YY1 lactylation axis provides a reliable and promising therapeutic direction for clinical treatment of ALI and ARDS.
authors: Li N, Liu Y, Gao M, Zhang W, Xiong R, Zuo Y, Lu X, Xu B, Miao C, Geng Q, Xie S, Wu X, Liu B.
screening_reason: Investigates the mechanistic role of site-specific protein lactylation (a post-translational modification) of YY1 during acute lung injury.
summary_ja: 本研究は、急性肺傷害（ALI）における乳酸依存的なタンパク質翻訳後修飾の病理的役割を明らかなにしました。肺傷害時に蓄積した乳酸は、アセチルトランスフェラーゼTip60を介して転写因子YY1の183番目リシン残基（K183）のラクチル化修飾を促進しました。このYY1 K183ラクチル化はPGC-1αの転写を抑制し、ミトコンドリアの恒常性破壊と肺胞上皮バリア障害を引き起こすことが示されました。
summary_en: The study investigated the biological functions of lactate-derived protein post-translational modification during acute lung injury. Accumulated lactate facilitated Tip60-dependent lactylation of the transcription factor YY1 at lysine 183. This site-specific lactylation suppressed PGC-1α expression, leading to mitochondrial dysfunction and alveolar epithelial barrier disruption.
key_finding_ja: 過剰な乳酸によって誘導される転写因子YY1のK183部位ラクチル化修飾が、PGC-1αの抑制を介してミトコンドリア障害と肺胞上皮バリア破綻を引き起こすことが見出された。
why_it_matters_ja: 乳酸駆動型のYY1ラクチル化軸を標的とすることで、急性呼吸窮迫症候群を含む急性肺傷害に対する新たな治療法の開発につながることが期待される。

title: Sex differences in the effects of shift work-like schedules on gut microbiome and intestinal barrier in relation to stroke survival.
abstract: Disturbances of 24-hour or circadian rhythms imposed by everyday irregular work and/or social schedules have been linked to vascular disease, including ischemic stroke. Using an established shift work-like paradigm and preclinical model for ischemic stroke, we have shown that environment-induced circadian dysregulation exacerbates stroke outcomes differentially to a greater extent in male than female rats. Because more severe stroke outcomes and circadian rhythm disturbances have been linked to gut pathophysiology, the present study examined the effects of chronic shifts in the LD cycle on gut cytoarchitecture, microbiota composition, metabolites, and inflammatory mediators for evidence of corresponding sex differences. Two independent cohorts of adult (5-7mo) rats exposed for 50d to fixed or shifted (12hr advance/5d) LD 12:12 cycles were used to examine the effects of circadian dysregulation on: fecal microbiome composition in relation to stroke survival (Cohort 1); and gut morphology, metabolites and inflammatory mediators (Cohort 2). Circadian entrainment of activity rhythms was stable during exposure to fixed LD cycles but was severely disrupted in shifted LD rats. Relative to fixed LD controls, male but not female rats exposed to shifted LD cycles were distinguished by significant alterations in the composition of the gut microbiome including reduced alpha diversity, shifts in beta diversity and correlations between the abundance of beneficial gut bacteria and stroke survival. The effects of circadian dysregulation on gut microbiota were accompanied by evidence of pathologic gut morphology (i.e., shorter and blunted villi, crypt hyperplasia, disruption of tight junction proteins and gut barrier integrity), decreased circulating levels of the neuroprotective short-chain fatty acid butyrate, and elevated serum concentrations of endotoxin and proinflammatory cytokine IL-17A in shifted LD male rats. These results suggest that alterations in gut cytoarchitecture, microbiota, metabolites and inflammatory mediators may contribute to sex differences in the effects of circadian dysregulation on ischemic stroke outcomes.
authors: Barnum E, Turck JL, Souza KA, Mani KK, Pilla R, Selvamani A, Sohrabji F, Earnest DJ.
screening_reason: Examines circadian disruption impacts on gut microbiome composition, gut barrier integrity, and stroke survival.
summary_ja: 本研究は、シフト勤務を模した明暗周期の乱れがラットの腸内細菌叢、腸管バリア機能、および脳卒中予後に及ぼす影響を性別ごとに検証しました。明暗周期を移動させた環境下において、雄ラットでは選択的に腸内細菌叢のα多様性の低下や組成変化、腸管バリア機能の破綻が認められました。さらに雄ラットでは、神経保護作用を有する短鎖脂肪酸である酪酸の減少に加え、血清中のエンドトキシンおよび炎症性サイトカインIL-17Aの上昇が観察されました。
summary_en: This study investigated the sex-dependent effects of shift work-like circadian disruption on the gut microbiome, intestinal barrier, and stroke outcomes in rats. Dysregulated light-dark schedules significantly altered gut microbiota composition, reduced alpha diversity, and impaired intestinal barrier integrity in male rats, but not in females. These gut microbiome and barrier disruptions in males were accompanied by decreased circulating butyrate and elevated systemic inflammatory markers.
key_finding_ja: シフト勤務を模した概日リズムの乱れは、雄ラットにおいて選択的に腸内細菌叢の多様性低下や腸管バリア障害、全身性炎症を誘導することが判明した。
why_it_matters_ja: 概日リズム障害が血管疾患予後に及ぼす影響には明確な性差が存在する可能性があり、個別の生活リズムに応じた腸内環境ケアの有効性を慎重に検討する必要がある。

title: Neuroinflammation, HPA Axis Dysregulation, Cytokine Activity and Nutritional Modulation in Depression: A PRISMA-compliant Systematic Review.
abstract: Background Depression is increasingly recognized as a multisystem disorder involving interconnected neuroinflammatory, neuroendocrine, metabolic and gut-brain mechanisms rather than isolated neurotransmitter abnormalities. Emerging evidence suggests that dysregulation of cytokine activity, hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal (HPA) axis function, oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction and gut microbiota collectively contribute to depressive pathophysiology. This review aimed to synthesise current evidence on these biological interactions and evaluate the potential role of nutritional modulation in influencing these pathways. Summary A PRISMA-informed systematic review was conducted using PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, Embase, PsycINFO and Google Scholar for studies published between 2010 and 2025. Thirty-five eligible studies were included. The evidence demonstrates a self-reinforcing biological network in which chronic stress activates the HPA axis, leading to glucocorticoid receptor resistance, increased pro-inflammatory cytokines, neuroinflammation, oxidative stress and gut microbiota dysbiosis. These interconnected mechanisms contribute to depressive symptoms and may perpetuate disease progression. Nutritional interventions, including Mediterranean dietary patterns, omega-3 fatty acids, dietary fibre, probiotics, polyphenols and selected micronutrients, consistently showed potential to reduce inflammation, regulate HPA axis activity, improve gut microbial balance and mitigate oxidative stress. Key message Depression should be conceptualised as a complex multisystem disorder driven by dynamic interactions among immune, endocrine, metabolic and microbiota-related pathways. Nutritional modulation represents a promising adjunctive strategy capable of targeting these interconnected biological mechanisms. Future longitudinal and interventional studies integrating multi-omics approaches are needed to validate causal pathways and develop personalised nutrition-based interventions for depression.
authors: Ts S, Yücel Ş, Gupta SK, Yücel R, Dutta S.
screening_reason: Systematic review focusing directly on neuroinflammation, gut microbiota dysbiosis, and biological network dysregulation in depression.
summary_ja: 本研究は、うつ病の病態における神経炎症、HPA軸異常、サイトカイン活性、腸内細菌叢の相互作用および栄養学的介入の役割に関する体系的レビューです。2010年から2025年までに発表された35件の研究を解析した結果、慢性ストレスがHPA軸活性化、グルココルチコイド受容体抵抗性、炎症性サイトカイン増大、腸内細菌叢悪化を引き起こす自己強化的な生物学的ネットワークが確認されました。地中海食、オメガ3脂肪酸、食物繊維、プロバイオティクス、ポリフェノールなどの栄養介入は、炎症低減やHPA軸調節、腸内細菌バランスの改善に寄与することが示されました。
summary_en: This systematic review synthesized evidence from 35 studies on the multisystem biological interactions underlying depression, including neuroinflammation, HPA axis dysregulation, oxidative stress, and gut dysbiosis. The findings highlight a self-reinforcing network of neuroendocrine and immune abnormalities. Nutritional interventions, such as Mediterranean diets, omega-3 fatty acids, dietary fiber, and probiotics, consistently demonstrated potential to modulate these interconnected pathways.
key_finding_ja: うつ病は免疫、内分泌、代謝、腸内細菌叢の経路が複合的に関与する多系統障害であり、栄養素による調節がこれらの悪循環を軽減し得ることが示された。
why_it_matters_ja: 多系統の免疫・内分泌経路を標的とした栄養学的アプローチが、うつ病の補助的治療戦略となる可能性が提示されている。

title: Kaempferol attenuates microglial activation in Alzheimer's disease via inhibiting the cytosolic HK2-mediated NF-κB signaling pathway.
abstract: Kaempferol (KAE), a natural flavonoid with substantial anti-inflammatory activity, has demonstrated efficacy against Alzheimer's disease (AD). However, the fundamental mechanisms are not yet fully understood. The objective of this study was to elucidate the role of KAE in alleviating microglia-mediated neuroinflammation in AD and its underlying mechanisms. The 3 × Tg-AD mice and LPS-stimulated BV2 microglial cells were employed as in vivo and in vitro model respectively. The HK-TAT peptide was utilized to induce mitochondrial dissociation of HK2, and 3-BP was applied as a HK2 inhibitor. Transcriptomic and metabolomic analyses were performed to discover the inhibitory effect of KAE on HK2. Immunofluorescence and Western blotting were employed to explore the suppressive role of KAE in cytosolic HK2-mediated NF-κB signaling. Additionally, the interaction between KAE and HK2 was investigated through molecular docking, validated by SPR, and confirmed via CETSA. Our findings demonstrated that KAE significantly attenuated LPS-induced microglial activation, along with the release of pro-inflammatory factors and enhanced glycolytic activity. In vivo, KAE partially rescued cognitive impairment and neuronal damage in 3 × Tg-AD mice. Microglial activation was also markedly suppressed. Mechanistically, we revealed that dissociation of HK2 from mitochondria to the cytosol was sufficient to induce microglial activation, and this process was consequently constrained by the suppression of HK2 level and activity using 3-BP. By reducing HK2 levels, KAE suppressed cytosolic HK2-mediated IκBα phosphorylation and subsequent nuclear translocation of NF-κB. Furthermore, KAE not only downregulated HK2 transcription but also bound to HK2, promoting its ubiquitination-mediated degradation. Our data indicate that KAE alleviates microglia-mediated neuroinflammation in AD, which correlates with the suppression of HK2 and the modulation of cytosolic HK2-dependent NF-κB activation.
authors: Wang M, Guo M, Li S, Song L, Wu M, Zhao J, Xu T, Zhou Y.
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
screening_reason: Focuses on kaempferol attenuating microglial activation and neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's disease via HK2 degradation and NF-kB signaling.
summary_ja: 本研究は、天然フラボノイドであるケンフェロール（KAE）がアルツハイマー病（AD）モデルにおいてミクログリア性神経炎症を抑制する分子メカニズムを解明しました。3×Tg-ADマウスおよびLPS刺激BV2ミクログリアを用いた実験により、ヘキソキナーゼ2（HK2）のミトコンドリアから細胞質への遊離がミクログリア活性化を引き起こすことを確認しました。KAEはHK2の転写抑制とユビキチン化分解促進を通じて細胞質HK2レベルを減少させ、IκBαリン酸化およびNF-κBの核内移行を阻害しました。これにより、3×Tg-ADマウスにおける認知機能障害や神経損傷、ミクログリアの過剰活性化が一部改善されました。
summary_en: This study investigated how kaempferol (KAE) attenuates microglia-mediated neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's disease models. KAE was found to target hexokinase 2 (HK2), suppressing its transcription and promoting its ubiquitination-mediated degradation. By reducing cytosolic HK2 levels, KAE inhibited downstream NF-κB activation, resulting in reduced microglial activation, partial rescue of cognitive impairment, and attenuation of neuronal damage in 3xTg-AD mice.
key_finding_ja: ケンフェロールはHK2の低下とユビキチン化分解を介して細胞質HK2依存性NF-κB経路を抑制し、ADモデルにおけるミクログリア活性化と認知機能障害を軽減した。
why_it_matters_ja: HK2を標的としたミクログリアの糖代謝および炎症経路の調節が、アルツハイマー病における神経炎症を抑える治療アプローチの候補となる可能性がある。

title: Disease-specific tau polymorphs are associated with unique protein networks across proteinopathies.
abstract: Tau protein aggregates adopt distinct conformations across tauopathies, yet the protein interactions engaged by disease-specific polymorphs remain poorly characterized. Here, we demonstrate that conformationally distinct tau polymorphs associate with disease-specific interaction networks across Alzheimer's disease (AD), progressive supranuclear palsy (PSP), and dementia with Lewy bodies (DLB). Interactome profiling of tau aggregates from PBS- and sarkosyl-soluble brain fractions identified 493 high-confidence interactors exhibiting remarkable disease specificity. As an exploratory feature discovery machine learning classification discriminated against diseases using as few as four to six protein features. AD tau selectively engaged glycolytic enzymes, TCA cycle components, and glutamate/GABA cycling machinery, with the astrocytic transporter SLC1A2 showing 27-fold enrichment. PSP tau exhibited extensive interactor depletion alongside selective proteasome enrichment, whereas DLB tau associated with neurogenesis modulators while depleting neuroinflammatory mediators. Interaction patterns were corroborated by parallel reaction monitoring mass spectrometry and proximity ligation assays and corresponded to disease-specific post-translational modification profiles. These findings show that tau polymorph conformations are associated with disease-specific interaction networks, providing molecular insight into tauopathy heterogeneity.
authors: Puangmalai N, Bhatt N, Suthprasertporn N, Miranda-Morales EG, Shchankin N, Samples M, Balci AE, Liew JY, Montalbano M, Zhao Y, Kayed R.
screening_reason: The study investigates disease-specific tau protein interactomes linked to distinct post-translational modification profiles across proteinopathies.
summary_ja: アルツハイマー病（AD）、進行性核上性麻痺（PSP）、レビー小体型認知症（DLB）において、タウ蛋白の病態特異的な多形（ポリモルフ）が異なる相互作用ネットワークを形成していることが判明しました。相互作用解析により、病態特異性を持つ493個の高信頼性タンパク質相互作用因子が特定されました。ADタウは糖代謝酵素や神経伝達物質循環系と選択的に結合し、PSPタウはプロテアソームの濃縮、DLBタウは神経発生調節因子との関連を示しました。これらの相互作用パターンは、各疾患固有の翻訳後修飾プロファイルと一致していました。
summary_en: Tau aggregate polymorphs across Alzheimer's disease, progressive supranuclear palsy, and dementia with Lewy bodies associate with distinct protein interaction networks. Interactome profiling revealed 493 disease-specific interactor proteins that match unique post-translational modification profiles. These findings provide molecular insights into the pathobiological heterogeneity of tauopathies.
key_finding_ja: 疾患特異的なタウ蛋白多形が異なる相互作用ネットワークを形成し、特定の翻訳後修飾プロファイルに対応していることが明かとなりました。
why_it_matters_ja: タウオパチーの病態多様性の解明が進み、疾患に応じた個別化診断や治療標的の開発につながることが期待されます。

title: Vagus Nerve Modulation of the Gut-Brain Axis: Implications for Mental Health and Cognitive Function.
abstract: The vagus nerve constitutes a core bidirectional pathway linking the central nervous system with peripheral organs and plays a fundamental role in gut-brain communication. Beyond its classical autonomic functions, accumulating evidence positions vagal signaling as a candidate integrative mechanism through which visceral, immune, and microbial inputs may modulate stress regulation, affective processing, cognition, and neuroplasticity. This narrative review synthesizes current anatomical and physiological knowledge of vagal pathways, with emphasis on afferent projections to the nucleus tractus solitarius and downstream modulation of noradrenergic, serotonergic, and cholinergic circuits involving the locus coeruleus, hippocampus, and prefrontal cortex. We further examine vagus nerve stimulation, including invasive and noninvasive approaches, as a neuromodulatory strategy for neurological and psychiatric disorders. Evidence is reviewed for its effects in epilepsy, mood and anxiety disorders, cognitive impairment, and neurodegenerative conditions, highlighting mechanisms such as synaptic plasticity enhancement, neuroimmune modulation, and regulation of hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis activity. While findings support the translational relevance of vagal modulation, variability in stimulation parameters and outcome measures limits cross-study comparison. Greater methodological standardization and integration of neurocognitive endpoints are required to clarify its clinical and neuroscientific significance.
authors: Álvarez-Mejía D, Mascialino G, Leon-Rojas JE.
journal: The Neuroscientist : a review journal bringing neurobiology, neurology and psychiatry
screening_reason: The paper focuses on vagal nerve signaling across the gut-brain axis, incorporating neuroimmune interaction and microbial/visceral input processing.
summary_ja: 迷走神経を介した腸脳軸が感情処理やストレス調節、認知機能に与える影響に関するナラティブレビューである。孤束核への求心性投射と、青斑核や海馬、前頭前皮質を含む下流の神経回路修飾メカニズムを解説している。さらに、神経免疫調節やHPA軸調節などを介した迷走神経刺激療法（VNS）の精神・神経疾患に対する応用可能性を整理している。研究間の刺激パラメーターのバラツキが課題であり、手法の標準化が求められている。
summary_en: This narrative review explores the anatomical and physiological pathways of vagal signaling in the gut-brain axis and its impact on affect and cognition. It details afferent projections to the nucleus tractus solitarius and downstream modulation of central neuromodulatory circuits. The review also evaluates invasive and noninvasive vagus nerve stimulation as potential treatments for neurological and psychiatric disorders.
key_finding_ja: 迷走神経伝達は脳内のモノアミン系回路や神経免疫系を制御し、感情や認知機能の調節に寄与する。
why_it_matters_ja: 迷走神経刺激療法の標準化が進めば、精神疾患や神経変性疾患に対する新たな治療アプローチの確立に貢献する可能性がある。

title: Novel natural inhibitor Rubimaillin targets NLRP3 R167/Y381 to ameliorate inflammatory and neurodegenerative diseases.
abstract: Ethnopharmacological relevance Rubia cordifolia L. is traditionally used in Chinese medicine for treating arthritic and inflammatory conditions by cooling blood and activating circulation. Gouty arthritis, one of the disease models investigated in this study, falls within this traditional anti-arthritic application. This study investigates whether rubimaillin (Rub), a naphthoquinone from Rubia cordifolia, selectively inhibits NLRP3 inflammasome activation and exerts therapeutic effects in relevant disease models. The NLR family pyrin domain-containing 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome is a key driver of various inflammatory, metabolic, and neurodegenerative disorders; yet, no clinically approved inhibitor is currently available. Rubia cordifolia L. is a traditional medicinal herb, and Rubimaillin (Rub), a naphthoquinone isolated from this herb, has potential anti-inflammatory properties, but its role and mechanism in regulating NLRP3 activation remain unclear. Aim of study This study aimed to determine whether Rubimaillin (Rub), a naphthoquinone isolated from Rubia cordifolia L., can selectively inhibit NLRP3 inflammasome activation and yield therapeutic effects in relevant NLRP3-driven disease models. Materials and methods Mouse primary microglia, bone marrow-derived macrophages (BMDMs), and the human macrophage cell line THP-1 were primed with lipopolysaccharide (LPS) for 3 h, then stimulated with Nigericin or ATP to induce NLRP3 inflammasome assembly and pyroptosis. Caspase-1 activation, apoptosis-associated speck-like protein containing a CARD (ASC) speck formation, interleukin-1β (IL-1β) release, and lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) secretion were quantified. Mutagenesis studies were conducted to identify critical residues required for Rub's binding to NLRP3. The in vivo therapeutic potential of Rub was assessed in three murine models of NLRP3-driven inflammation: LPS-induced sepsis, monosodium urate crystal (MSU)-induced gouty arthritis, and the APP/PS1 double-transgenic Alzheimer's disease (AD) mouse model. Mice received intraperitoneal Rub or vehicle, and disease severity was evaluated by histopathology, cytokine profiling, and behavioral tests. Results Rub significantly reduced pyroptosis and IL-1β release in mouse primary microglia, BMDMs, and THP-1 cells in a dose-dependent manner, without affecting Absent in melanoma 2(AIM2) or NLR family CARD domain containing 4 (NLRC4) pathways. Mechanistically, Rub directly bound to NLRP3, thereby blocking the oligomerization of both NLRP3 and ASC, as well as preventing caspase-1 activation and gasdermin D (GSDMD) cleavage. Furthermore, mutagenesis studies identified arginine 167 and tyrosine 381 as critical residues for Rub's binding to NLRP3. In vivo, Rub treatment significantly prolonged survival and attenuated lung injury in the sepsis model, reduced paw swelling and bone erosion in the gout model, and ameliorated cognitive deficits and neuroinflammation in the AD model, respectively. Conclusion Collectively, these findings demonstrate that Rub selectively targets the NLRP3 inflammasome and exerts therapeutic effects on NLRP3-driven diseases including sepsis, gout, and AD. This study provides a molecular basis for the traditional application of Rubia cordifolia L. and highlights Rub as a promising natural lead compound for the treatment of NLRP3-driven disorders.
authors: Xiao J, Lan Z, Zhang R, Zhang J, Hu Z, Jia B, Tang H, Xu T, Bao X, Xu Y, Yu L, Ji SL, Zhu X.
screening_reason: Mechanistic study of NLRP3 inflammasome inhibition attenuating microglial activation and neuroinflammation in an Alzheimer's disease model.
summary_ja: 茜草由来のナフトキノン化合物ルビマイリン（Rubimaillin）が、NLRP3インフラマソームを微量で選択的に阻害することを報告しました。ルビマイリンはNLRP3のR167およびY381残基に直接結合し、NLRP3およびASCのオリゴマー化とパイロトーシスを抑制しました。生体モデルにおいて、ルビマイリン投与は敗血症、痛風性関節炎、およびアルツハイマー病モデルでの神経炎症と認知機能障害を有意に軽減しました。
summary_en: The study identified rubimaillin, a natural naphthoquinone compound, as a selective inhibitor of the NLRP3 inflammasome. Mechanistically, rubimaillin directly binds to the R167 and Y381 residues of NLRP3, blocking its oligomerization, caspase-1 activation, and cell death. In vivo, rubimaillin treatment significantly attenuated disease severity in sepsis, gouty arthritis, and Alzheimer's disease models.
key_finding_ja: ルビマイリンはNLRP3のR167およびY381残基に直接結合することでインフラマソーム活性化を阻害し、敗血症、痛風、アルツハイマー病モデルでの炎症症状を改善した。
why_it_matters_ja: NLRP3インフラマソームの特異的結合部位を阻害する天然化合物の発見は、神経変性疾患や多様な炎症性疾患に対する新規治療薬開発に資する可能性がある。

title: Intranasal insulin reduces ADHD-like behaviors and neurodevelopmental deficits following neonatal hypoxia-ischemia in juvenile rats.
abstract: Neonatal hypoxia-ischemia (HI) is a leading cause of long-term neurodevelopmental impairment and is increasingly associated with a heightened risk of attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) and related behavioral abnormalities. Beyond its metabolic role, insulin functions as a neurotrophic and immunomodulatory factor in the developing brain. However, whether early enhancement of central insulin signaling can mitigate the neuroinflammatory and behavioral sequelae of HI remains unclear. Male and female Sprague-Dawley rats were subjected to HI (right common carotid artery ligation followed by 90 minutes of 8% oxygen) at P10 and randomized to Sham+Vehicle, Sham+Insulin, HI+Vehicle, or HI+Insulin groups (n = 12 males and 12 females/group). Recombinant human insulin (rhInsulin) (50 μg/day) was administered intranasally once daily from P10 to P12, and behavioral and histological outcomes were assessed at P21-P25. Neonatal HI produced persistent ADHD-like behavioral abnormalities and deficits in neurobiological outcomes. Notably, sex-specific responses were observed: males exhibited greater deficits in inattention, spatial working memory, impulsivity, adaptive social development, myelination and vascularization, whereas females showed more pronounced increases in repetitive and compulsive-like behaviors. Intranasal rhInsulin treatment significantly attenuated HI-induced behavioral deficits by 100% and increased myelination (MBP+) by 64% in cingulate white matter, restored dendritic expression (MAP2+) by 56%, and reduced astrocytes (GFAP+) by 70% in hippocampal regions, indicating suppression of chronic astrogliosis neuroinflammation. Furthermore, intranasal rhInsulin increased cerebral vascular volume by 49% and normalized vessel diameters as assessed by micro-computed tomography (microCT) imaging, suggesting enhanced neurovascular integrity. While our previous study demonstrated that intranasal rhInsulin attenuated acute brain injury, neuronal apoptosis, and short-term sensorimotor deficits following neonatal hypoxia-ischemia (HI), its effects on long-term neurodevelopmental outcomes remained unclear. The present study addresses this important knowledge gap by evaluating juvenile behavioral and neurobiological outcomes through P25, including ADHD-like behaviors, social deficits, repetitive behaviors, white matter integrity, astrogliosis, cerebrovascular development, and sex-specific treatment responses. Collectively, these findings identify central insulin signaling as a key regulator of post-HI neuroimmune and neurodevelopmental trajectories and support intranasal insulin as a promising, minimally invasive therapeutic approach to reduce the long-term neurobehavioral sequelae of neonatal brain injury.
authors: Dankhara N, Lee JW, Ojeda NB, Tucci MA, Lu S, Childers KE, Klim M, Lockett TZ, Valentine AS, Glendye CK, Tien LT, Salazar Marocho SM, da Silva AA, Pang Y, Bhatt AJ, Fan LW.
screening_reason: Investigates central insulin regulation of neuroimmune trajectories and suppression of neuroinflammation following neonatal hypoxia-ischemia.
summary_ja: 本研究では、新生児期脳虚血低酸素症（HI）後の神経炎症および行動障害に対する経鼻インスリン投与の軽減効果をラットモデルで評価しました。HI処置により性差を伴うADHD様行動異常や髄鞘形成障害、アストロサイトの活性化による神経炎症が持続して誘発されました。生後早期の経鼻インスリン投与は、GFAP陽性アストロサイトの増殖を抑制して神経炎症を和らげ、髄鞘形成および脳血管構造を回復させて行動障害を改善しました。
summary_en: This study evaluated whether early intranasal insulin administration could attenuate neuroinflammatory and behavioral deficits after neonatal hypoxia-ischemia (HI) in rats. Neonatal HI induced persistent ADHD-like behavioral abnormalities, neurovascular impairment, and chronic astrogliosis with distinct sex-dependent responses. Intranasal insulin treatment effectively attenuated behavioral deficits, suppressed GFAP-positive astrogliosis, and restored myelination and cerebrovascular integrity.
key_finding_ja: 新生児期脳虚血低酸素症後の経鼻インスリン投与が、アストロサイト依存的な神経炎症を抑え、ADHD様行動異常や脳発達障害を顕著に軽減することが示された。
why_it_matters_ja: 中枢インスリンシグナル調整が周産期脳障害に伴う長期的神経発達障害に対する低侵襲な神経免疫療法となる可能性があり、さらなる検討が期待される。

title: Aquaporin-4 mediated glymphatic dysfunction and neuroinflammatory signaling in neurodegenerative disorders.
abstract: Aquaporin channels are the predominant fluid regulating channel found in the central nervous system (CNS) and plays a pivotal role in maintaining fluid and ion homeostasis, as well as regulating neuroinflammation, neurodegeneration, and blood-brain barrier (BBB) disruption. This protein is primarily located at astrocytes endfeet within the blood cerebral barrier and other central nervous system (CNS) junctions, facilitating the movement of water in both directions, buffering potassium levels, and aiding in the clearance of interstitial solutes, along with toxic metabolites such as amyloid-β, via the glymphatic system. Changes in the expression or polarization of AQPs are implicated in neurodegenerative conditions such as Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, epilepsy, and ischemic stroke. Impaired functionality of AQPs is involved in a number of pathological processes including heightened oxidative stress, disruption of the blood-brain barrier, and neuroinflammation. Such pathways are targeted by transcription factors, including nuclear factor κB (NFκB), and signaling pathways, including p38 MAPK, that increase AQPs expression following the action of stressors. Furthermore, impairment of AQPs polarity suppresses glymphatic clearance and promotes toxic protein accumulation, one of the key features of Alzheimer 's disease. AQPs structural features, including its six transmembrane helices and conserved NPA motifs, are critical for function, positioning it as a putative therapeutic target. Preclinical data support the notion that modulation of AQPs activity may offer neuroprotection through restoration of homeostasis and reduction of inflammation in neurodegenerative disease. This review describes the mechanistic links between AQPs dysfunction and neurodegenerative disease, highlighting its potential and limitations as a therapeutic target for the prevention of CNS disorders.
authors: Singh B, Singh S, Banerjee S, Bhargava S, Subramaniyan V, Singh TG.
screening_reason: Examines aquaporin-4 mediated glymphatic dysfunction and central nervous system neuroinflammatory signaling in neurodegenerative disease.
summary_ja: 中枢神経系におけるアストロサイト足胞のアクアポリン4（AQP4）を介した水・イオン恒常性維持とグリンファティック系による老廃物除去の役割を概説した総説である。AQP4の極性消失や機能不全が、血液脳関門の破綻、酸化ストレス、神経炎症を引き起こす機序を記載している。これらの経路にはNF-κBやp38 MAPKなどのシグナル伝達系が関与し、アルツハイマー病などの病態進行に関連している。AQP4活性の制御が神経変性疾患における保護的介入標的となり得る可能性を説明している。
summary_en: This review outlines the essential role of aquaporin-4 (AQP4) channels in maintaining central nervous system fluid homeostasis and mediating glymphatic clearance. Impairment of AQP4 polarity promotes oxidative stress, blood-brain barrier disruption, and neuroinflammation through pathways such as NF-κB and p38 MAPK. Consequently, targeting AQP4 functionality represents a potential neuroprotective strategy for managing neurodegenerative disorders.
key_finding_ja: AQP4の機能障害と極性の消失は、グリンファティック系による毒性タンパク質の除去を低下させ神経炎症を増悪させる。
why_it_matters_ja: AQP4を標的としたシグナル制御は、アルツハイマー病などの神経変性疾患における神経炎症の抑制と組織恒常性の回復に寄与する可能性がある。

title: Low Dose Naltrexone in Depression: A Mechanistic Systematic Review of Convergent Neuroimmune Suppression and Endogenous Opioid Plasticity as a Mechanistic Framework
authors: Uppal G, Mohamed F, Gul N, Babu B, Pandian K.
screening_reason: The systematic review focuses on neuroimmune suppression and endogenous opioid plasticity as mechanistic frameworks in depression.
summary_ja: うつ病に対する低用量ナルトレキソンの治療機序に関するシステマティックレビューです。神経免疫抑制および内因性オピオイド系の可塑性を中心とした作用メカニズムの枠組みを提案しています。精神疾患治療における新たな薬理学的アプローチの可能性を論述しています。アブストラクトの本文情報は提供されていません。
summary_en: This systematic review evaluates the mechanistic framework of low-dose naltrexone in depression. It focuses on convergent neuroimmune suppression and endogenous opioid plasticity as therapeutic drivers. The review discusses potential pathways through which this pharmacotherapy exerts antidepressant effects.
key_finding_ja: 低用量ナルトレキソンのうつ病改善効果に神経免疫抑制とオピオイド可塑性が関与する統合的メカニズムが提示されました。
why_it_matters_ja: 神経免疫修飾を標的とした抗うつ治療の概念を深め、既存薬の再開発や病態に応じた創薬研究に貢献する可能性があります。

title: Biological Mechanisms of Psychotherapeutic Change: A Systematic Review of Neuroimmune, Autonomic and Epigenetic Changes Following CBT, Mindfulness Based and Trauma-Focused Therapies
authors: Gul N, Uppal G, Maryum M, Padiyan K, Babu B.
screening_reason: The systematic review's primary focus is on neuroimmune and autonomic biological mechanisms of psychotherapeutic change.
summary_ja: 認知行動療法（CBT）、マインドフルネス、トラウマ焦点型療法などの心理療法施行後における生物学的変化を評価したシステマティックレビューです。神経免疫系、自律神経系、およびエピジェネティクスにおける変動メカニズムについて考察されています。心理的介入が身体的・生理学的指標に及ぼす影響を包括的に整理しています。アブストラクトの本文情報は提供されていません。
summary_en: This systematic review synthesizes biological mechanisms of change following psychotherapies such as CBT, mindfulness, and trauma-focused therapies. It evaluates post-treatment shifts in neuroimmune, autonomic, and epigenetic markers. The review provides insight into how psychological interventions alter physiological systems.
key_finding_ja: 心理療法介入後における神経免疫系、自律神経系、エピジェネティクス変化の機序がシステマティックレビューとしてまとめられました。
why_it_matters_ja: 心理療法の生物学的基盤を裏付けることで、精神疾患に対する心身両面からの治療戦略の発展に寄与する可能性があります。

title: Heat-Stress Alters the Effects of Antibiotics on Fish Behavior.
abstract: Antibiotics are a common contaminant of freshwaters, yet surprisingly understudied compared to other classes of drugs. Even trace concentrations of antibiotics can alter the gut microbiome, in turn affecting multiple systems including physiology, biochemistry, and behavior. Concurrently, climate change is leading to higher average temperatures and more frequent temperature spikes. The microbiome of poikilotherms is also highly sensitive to temperature. Little is known of how these two stressors interact. In this study we investigated the effects of amoxicillin, an antibiotic that is widely used in human and veterinary medicine, on the swimming behavior and predatory avoidance responses of zebrafish at two temperatures, 28°C (normal) and 32°C (heat-stressed). Additionally, we investigated the effects of the two stressors on the gut microbiome and heat shock protein expression. Both temperature and amoxicillin affected key behaviors including boldness, sociability, and swimming speed, with fish exposed to low-dose amoxicillin having higher swimming velocity suggesting a possible hormesis response. Amoxicillin exposure also increased fish boldness, while temperature had the opposite effect. A high temperature also reduced fish sociability. Both stressors also altered zebrafish responses to a conspecific alarm cue and induced heat shock protein gene expression. Heat stress and amoxicillin both altered the fish gut microbiome at the genus level with heat stress alone increasing several genera (e.g., Nordella, Nocardia, Reyranella), while heat stress plus high amoxicillin (20 μg/L) further increased others (e.g., Bradyrhizobium, Legionella, Xanthobacter). Overall alpha diversity (Shannon) changed little, but community composition (ANOSIM) shifted most clearly under high amoxicillin and under heat combined with amoxicillin, indicating dose- and temperature-dependent restructuring of the gut microbiome. Overall, the microbiome is emerging as an important regulator of physiology and behavior that is vulnerable to multiple stressors.
authors: Al Shuraiqi A, Al-Ansari A, Al-Habsi A, Abed RMM, Barry MJ.
screening_reason: Studies the impact of environmental antibiotics and heat stress on the fish gut microbiome and host behavior.
summary_ja: ゼブラフィッシュを用いて、環境汚染物質である抗生剤アモキシシリンと熱ストレスが行動および腸内細菌叢に与える複合的な影響を検証した実験研究である。アモキシシリン曝露と高温環境の両者が泳動速度、大胆さ、社会性、危険警戒応答などの行動に著しい影響を及ぼした。また、両ストレス要因はヒートショックタンパク質遺伝子の発現を誘発するとともに、腸内細菌叢の構成を属レベルで変化させた。高濃度のアモキシシリンと熱ストレスの併用により細菌叢の多様性パターンおよび群集構造が著しくシフトすることが確認された。
summary_en: This study evaluated the combined effects of amoxicillin exposure and heat stress on zebrafish behavior and gut microbiome composition. Both stressors altered swimming behavior, boldness, and social interaction, alongside inducing heat shock protein gene expression. High-dose amoxicillin coupled with elevated temperatures driven by heat stress induced significant restructuring of the gut microbial community.
key_finding_ja: 抗生剤曝露と熱ストレスの併用はゼブラフィッシュの行動異常を引き起こし、腸内細菌叢の群集構造を顕著に変化させる。
why_it_matters_ja: 気候変動による水温上昇と薬剤汚染の複合作用が水生生物の腸内細菌叢や行動に及ぼす影響を理解することは、環境リスク評価において重要である。

title: Can you run from your worries? The effects of exercise on anxiety-like behaviour and immune signaling in female and male mice.
abstract: Exercise is a positive health behaviour associated with improved mood. However, the mechanisms underlying the benefits of exercise on affective health are unclear, particularly with respect to type of exercise and sex. Chronic exercise decreases neuroinflammation, which is linked to improvements in mood and anxiety. However, exercise is also a physiological stressor that can transiently upregulate systemic inflammation, and its effects on neuroinflammation are not well understood. This study examined how acute and chronic exercise affect circulating and brain cytokine levels and anxiety-related behaviour in young healthy male and female mice. In Experiment 1, mice were placed on a treadmill for a two-hour bout of moderate exercise. Two hours after exercise, animals were either tested in the open field or euthanized for measurement of cytokines (IL-1β, TNF, IL-2, IL-4, IL-5, IL-6, IL-10, IL-12p70, IFN-γ, KC/GRO). In Experiment 2, mice underwent an 8-week moderate treadmill exercise paradigm followed by open field testing and tissue collection. Acute exercise decreased time spent in the centre of the open field in males only, suggesting increased anxiety-like behaviour in males. Acute exercise increased IL-6 and decreased TNF in serum, and increased amygdala principal component 1 (loading IL-12p70, IL-10, IFN-γ, and TNF) in both sexes. Chronic exercise increased open field centre entries, increased IL-6 in the prefrontal cortex, decreased TNF in the dorsal hippocampus, and had minimal effects on circulating cytokines in both sexes. These results demonstrate that the effects of exercise on anxiety-related behaviour and cytokine levels depend on recurrence, tissue, and brain region.
authors: Maheu MG, Mazur J, Melekh E, King M, Attlas G, Cook EL, Bellaflor S, Qureshi SF, Mohammad A, Beaudette SM, MacPherson RE, Duarte-Guterman P.
screening_reason: Investigates the impact of acute and chronic exercise on brain neuroinflammation, cytokine profiles, and anxiety-like behaviors.
summary_ja: 若年マウスを対象に、単回および長期のトレッドミル運動が不安様行動と血中および脳内サイトカインに与える影響を検討した研究である。単回運動は雄マウスでのみオープンフィールド中央滞在時間を減らし不安様行動を増加させたが、血清および扁桃体のサイトカイン構成を変化させた。一方で8週間の長期運動は、性別を問わずオープンフィールド中央への侵入を増加させ、前頭前皮質のIL-6上昇と海馬のTNF低下を引き起こした。以上の結果から、運動が行動や炎症シグナルに及ぼす効果は、運動の継続期間や脳部位、性別に依存することが示された。
summary_en: This study investigated how acute and chronic treadmill exercise affects anxiety-like behavior and cytokine profiles in male and female mice. Acute exercise transiently increased anxiety-like behavior in males while altering serum and amygdaloid cytokine levels in both sexes. Conversely, 8 weeks of chronic exercise reduced anxiety-like behavior and differentially modulated cytokine levels in the prefrontal cortex and hippocampus.
key_finding_ja: 運動が及ぼす不安様行動や脳内炎症シグナルへの影響は、単回か長期かという運動形式や性別、脳部位によって異なる。
why_it_matters_ja: 運動の種類や期間による神経免疫系および行動への影響の違いを把握することは、性差に応じた適切な精神健康増進アプローチの設計につながる可能性がある。

title: Prenatal exposure to organophosphate esters and infantile neurobehavior: Integrating the gut microbiome and metabolome.
abstract: Organophosphate esters (OPEs) are widely used flame retardants and plasticizers. Given their structural similarity to neurotoxic organophosphorus pesticides, concerns have been raised regarding their potential developmental neurotoxicity. However, epidemiologic evidence remains limited, and the roles of gut microbial and metabolic perturbations in these associations are not well characterized. We analyzed 404 mother-child pairs from the Shanghai Maternal-Child Pairs Cohort. OPE concentrations were quantified in cord serum. Meconium samples were profiled for gut microbiota and metabolomics, and behavioral development at 2 years was assessed using the Strengths and Difficulties Questionnaire. Generalized linear models, negative-binomial hurdle regression, SHapley Additive exPlanations, high-dimensional mediation analysis, metabolome-wide association analysis, meet-in-the-middle analysis, and pathway enrichment analysis were applied. A doubling of cord serum tris(2-butoxyethyl) phosphate (TBEP) concentration was associated with a 0.09-point increase in the conduct problem score at age 2 years (95% confidence interval [CI]: 0.02, 0.16). A doubling of TBEP concentration was also associated with 7.9% higher Chao1 richness (95% CI: 2.8%, 14.1%) and 8.7% higher ACE richness (95% CI: 3.5%, 14.1%). A doubling of Chao1 and ACE richness was associated with 0.27-point (95% CI: 0.12, 0.42) and 0.31-point (95% CI: 0.15, 0.46) increases in conduct problem scores, respectively. Alpha diversity indices and Collinsella were identified as potential mediators of the TBEP-conduct problem association. Integrated metabolomic analyses further implicated five pathways, particularly catecholamine biosynthesis and tyrosine metabolism. Enrichment scores for these pathways were positively associated with Chao1, ACE, and Collinsella. Prenatal TBEP exposure was associated with greater behavioral problems in early childhood. Altered neonatal gut microbiota and related metabolic pathways may partly underlie this association.
authors: Zhou Y, Zhang L, Li Q, Wang H, Shi H, Zhao Y, Xiao X, Zhang Y.
screening_reason: Integrates gut microbiome alterations and microbial metabolic pathways with developmental neurotoxicity in children.
summary_ja: 有機リン酸エステル（OPE）であるTBEPの胎児期曝露と2歳時の行動問題との関連を解析した母子コホート研究である。臍帯血中TBEP濃度の増加は2歳時の素行問題スコアの上昇および胎便中の腸内細菌叢α多様性の増加と関連していた。高次元中介解析などにより、腸内細菌叢の多様性やCollinsella属、カテコールアミン合成経路などの代謝変動がこの関連の一部を媒介している可能性が示された。
summary_en: In a cohort of 404 mother-child pairs, prenatal exposure to tris(2-butoxyethyl) phosphate (TBEP) was associated with higher conduct problem scores in children at age 2. TBEP exposure was also linked to increased neonatal gut microbial alpha diversity and alterations in specific bacterial taxa like Collinsella. Integrated metabolomic analysis suggested that gut microbiota shifts and catecholamine/tyrosine metabolic pathways may partially mediate TBEP-induced neurobehavioral effects.
key_finding_ja: 臍帯血中TBEP濃度の上昇は2歳時点での子供の素行問題スコア増加と関連し、新生児の腸内細菌叢および特定の代謝経路がこの関連を媒介している可能性が示された。
why_it_matters_ja: 環境化学物質による発達神経毒性の背景に腸内細菌叢や代謝系の変化が関与している可能性を示唆するが、因果関係の解明にはさらなる検証が必要である。

title: Maternal co-exposure to polystyrene microplastics and DEHP impairs thyroid function in adult rat offspring.
abstract: Maternal combined exposure to polystyrene microplastics (PS-MPs) and di-(2-ethylhexyl) phthalate (DEHP) poses potential risks to offspring endocrine development; however, the combined effects of these two contaminants remain poorly characterized. Pregnant rats were exposed to PS-MPs, DEHP or a combination of both throughout pregnancy and lactation. The hypothalamic-pituitary-thyroid (HPT) axis function and gut microbiota composition were then assessed in adult offspring. Single-contaminant exposure altered thyroid hormone levels and HPT axis gene expression. Co-exposure exacerbated these disruptions, producing greater TSH suppression, elevated thyroid hormone levels, and uniform downregulation of Nis expression in offspring of both sexes. Sex-specific differences in hypothalamic and pituitary gene expression were observed, suggesting that upstream HPT axis regulation was disrupted via sex-divergent mechanisms. The combined exposure also induced morphological disruption of thyroid follicular epithelial cells and elevated oxidative stress markers. In co-exposed offspring, gut microbiome profiling revealed Bacteroides depletion and Enterococcus enrichment as the most prominent taxa-level shifts. The parallel perturbations in gut microbiome composition and HPT axis function across treatment groups support a proposed disruption model of the gut-brain-thyroid axis. Our findings demonstrate that maternal co-exposure to PS-MPs and DEHP induces sex-divergent thyroid endocrine disruption in offspring, driven by a complex integration of additive and synergistic toxicities. Consequently, relying exclusively on single-pollutant models likely underestimates the developmental health threats of real-world plastic mixtures, highlighting the critical need to incorporate mixture interactions and sex-specific vulnerabilities into future environmental risk assessments.
authors: Zhang X, Li J, Yang Z, Zheng S, Huang Q, Meng F, Zhang Y.
screening_reason: Directly investigates gut microbiome alterations and gut-brain-thyroid axis disruptions caused by maternal plasticizer co-exposure.
summary_ja: 本研究は、妊娠・授乳期におけるポリスチレンマイクロプラスチック（PS-MP）とフタル酸ジエチルヘキシル（DEHP）の複合曝露が、成長後の子ラットの甲状腺機能と腸内細菌叢に与える影響を評価しました。複合曝露は単独曝露に比べ、甲状腺刺激ホルモンの強固な抑制や甲状腺ホルモン異常、甲状腺濾胞上皮の構造破壊を拡大させました。同時に腸内細菌叢ではBacteroidesの減少とEnterococcusの増加が確認され、腸-脳-甲状腺軸の乱れが示唆されました。
summary_en: This study examined the effects of maternal co-exposure to polystyrene microplastics and DEHP on thyroid function and gut microbiota in adult rat offspring. Combined exposure exacerbated systemic thyroid disruption, TSH suppression, and follicular cell damage beyond single-contaminant toxicity. Gut microbiome profiling revealed prominent shifts, specifically Bacteroides depletion and Enterococcus enrichment, supporting a disrupted gut-brain-thyroid axis.
key_finding_ja: ポリスチレンマイクロプラスチックとDEHPへの母体複合曝露が、子ラットの甲状腺機能を相乗的に阻害し、腸内細菌叢のバランス障害を引き起こすことが明らかになった。
why_it_matters_ja: 単一汚染物質モデルのみでは実際の環境リスクを過小評価する危険性があり、腸内細菌叢を含む内分泌攪乱毒性の全容解明に向けた複合曝露評価が必要とされる。

title: Prospective associations of tea consumption with skeletal muscle mass and strength: Insights from the gut microbiome and proteomics.
abstract: Tea consumption may be associated with skeletal muscle health, but longitudinal evidence based on repeated assessments remains limited. We examined the associations of tea intake and serum biomarkers with repeated skeletal muscle measures and explored whether these associations might be partly explained by multi-omics features. In this prospective cohort, 3408 adults were followed for approximately 12 years. Skeletal muscle mass was measured by dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry, handgrip strength by digital dynamometry, gut microbial taxonomic and functional profiles by shotgun metagenomic sequencing, serum proteins by data-independent acquisition mass spectrometry, and fecal metabolites by targeted UPLC-MS/MS metabolomics. Linear mixed-effects models examined longitudinal associations, and mediation analyses estimated indirect effects. In longitudinal analyses, higher tea consumption frequency was associated with greater appendicular skeletal muscle mass, appendicular skeletal muscle index, and handgrip strength (β: 0.037-0.140; 95% CI: 0.002-0.205). Higher circulating flavan-3-ols showed similar associations with these muscle-related outcomes (β: 0.085-0.174; 95% CI: 0.007-0.254), whereas no significant associations were observed with walking speed. Exploratory multi-omics analyses identified tea-related differences in gut microbial species and functional pathways, fecal metabolites, and circulating proteins, including Gemmiger formicilis, amino acid biosynthesis pathways, fructose 1,6-bisphosphate, VTN, CFI, CNDP1, and ITIH4. Exploratory mediation analyses identified statistical indirect associations involving multi-omics features, with estimated proportions mediated ranging from 4.5% to 19.0%. Overall, higher tea consumption and circulating biomarkers were associated with greater skeletal muscle mass and strength, accompanied by distinct multi-omics features that may provide potential biological links between tea exposure and muscle-related outcomes.
authors: Hong Z, Lu Z, Shi R, Zheng S, Luo J, Chen J, Xie Z, Zheng JS, Chen YM, Zhang Z.
screening_reason: Investigates longitudinal associations between tea consumption, gut microbiome profiles, microbial pathways, and muscle health.
summary_ja: 3408人の成人を約12年間追跡した前向きコホート研究において、お茶の摂取頻度および血中フラバン-3-オール濃度と骨格筋量・筋力との縦断的関連が調査された。解析の結果、高いお茶の摂取頻度や血中フラバン-3-オール濃度は、四肢骨格筋量や握力の高さと正の関連を示した。マルチオミクス解析により、Gemmiger formicilisなどの腸内細菌や糞便代謝物、特定の血中タンパク質にお茶摂取に関連する変化が見出された。媒介分析では、これらのマルチオミクス特徴量が統計的な間接効果を示すことが観察された。
summary_en: In a prospective cohort study following 3,408 adults for approximately 12 years, higher tea consumption frequency and circulating flavan-3-ols were associated with greater appendicular skeletal muscle mass and handgrip strength. Multi-omics analyses revealed tea-related variations in gut microbial taxa, fecal metabolites, and circulating proteins. Exploratory mediation analyses indicated that these multi-omics features statistically mediated a portion of the prospective associations.
key_finding_ja: お茶の摂取頻度および血中フラバン-3-オール濃度が高いことは、四肢骨格筋量や握力の維持・増加と縦断的に関連しており、特定の腸内細菌や血中タンパク質などのマルチオミクス特徴がその媒介要因として示唆された。
why_it_matters_ja: お茶の摂取と筋力・骨格筋量との関連に腸内細菌叢やタンパク質などのマルチオミクス特徴が関与している可能性を示しており、加齢に伴う筋肉減弱に対する栄養学的アプローチの理解に繋がる可能性がある。

title: COVID-19 and the Forgotten Organ: Prolonged Changes to the Metabolic Output of the Gut Microbiome.
authors: Venzon M, Cadwell K.
screening_reason: The study's primary topic concerns long-term metabolic output changes of the gut microbiome following COVID-19.
summary_ja: COVID-19感染後における腸内細菌叢の代謝出力および機能的変化に焦点を当てた論文です。感染が腸内微生物コミュニティの代謝機能に及ぼす持続的な影響について論じられています。腸内細菌叢が及ぼす全身性の代謝的役割が考察されています。アブストラクトの本文情報は提供されていません。
summary_en: This article examines prolonged alterations in the metabolic output of the gut microbiome following COVID-19 infection. It highlights the functional impact of viral infection on intestinal microbial metabolism over time. The piece discusses the role of the microbiome as a key factor in post-viral systemic changes.
key_finding_ja: COVID-19感染が腸内細菌叢の代謝出力に対して長期的な変化を引き起こす可能性が議論されています。
why_it_matters_ja: COVID-19後遺症における腸内代謝の関与を理解することで、微生物叢に着目した新たな回復促進策の検討に繋がる可能性があります。

title: Phoenixin-14 as a Potential Limiting Neuropeptide for Exaggerated Inflammation in Familial Mediterranean Fever and Periodic Fever, Aphthous Stomatitis, Pharyngitis, and Cervical Adenitis: A Comparative Study.
abstract: Objective This study aimed to evaluate serum phoenixin-14 (PNX-14) levels in patients with familial Mediterranean fever (FMF) and periodic fever, aphthous stomatitis, pharyngitis, and cervical adenitis (PFAPA) during both attack and attack-free periods to investigate its potential biomarker value. Methods In total, 140 children were included in this cross-sectional study: 46 with FMF, 48 with PFAPA, and 46 healthy children. Blood samples were collected during both febrile and attack-free periods in the patients with FMF and PFAPA, whereas samples from healthy controls were collected at a single timepoint. C-reactive protein (CRP), erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR), serum amyloid A (SAA), fibrinogen, and serum PNX-14 levels were evaluated. Serum PNX-14 levels were measured using ELISA. SPSS 25 (IBM) was used for statistical analyses. Results PNX-14 levels were significantly higher during attack periods in FMF and PFAPA patients compared to attack-free periods and healthy controls ( P P P = 0.04), no significant correlation was observed with ESR, SAA, or fibrinogen. No significant associations were observed between PNX-14 levels and disease severity (Pras disease severity score), colchicine treatment duration, or daily colchicine dose in the FMF group. Conclusion PNX-14 may be part of a neuroimmune response aimed at resolving inflammation in autoinflammatory processes and could be a potential immunomodulatory biomarker. PNX-14 may be a complementary indicator reflecting inflammatory burden or the healing process.
authors: Ayduran S, Kılbaş G, Tığrak SN, Kaleli İ, Demir M, Türkuçar S.
screening_reason: Investigates the neuropeptide phoenixin-14 as a neuroimmune regulator in autoinflammatory pediatric fever disorders.
summary_ja: 家族性地中海熱（FMF）およびPFAPA症候群の小児患者46名および48名と、健常対照群46名を対象に、血清フェニキシン-14（PNX-14）濃度を評価する横断研究が行われた。発作期のPNX-14濃度は、非発作期および健常対照群と比較して有意に高い値を示した。また、PNX-14濃度はCRPと中等度の正の相関を示したが、ESRや病勢度スコア、コルヒチン治療とは有意な関連が認められなかった。PNX-14は自己炎症過程における炎症消退を目指す神経免疫応答の一部である可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This cross-sectional study evaluated serum phoenixin-14 (PNX-14) levels in 140 children, including those with FMF, PFAPA, and healthy controls. Serum PNX-14 levels were significantly elevated during attack periods compared to attack-free periods and healthy controls, showing a moderate positive correlation with CRP. The findings suggest PNX-14 may participate in a neuroimmune response involved in resolving inflammation during autoinflammatory attacks.
key_finding_ja: FMFおよびPFAPA患者の発作期において血清PNX-14濃度が有意に上昇しており、CRPと正の相関を示すことが明らかになった。
why_it_matters_ja: PNX-14が自己炎症性疾患における炎症制御に関与する神経ペプチドバイオマーカーとして機能する可能性が期待される。

title: Neurodegeneration as an early driver and therapeutic target in diabetic retinopathy.
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) is conventionally recognized as a microvascular complication of diabetes mellitus. Nevertheless, accumulating evidence confirms that early retinal neurodegeneration develops in the course of diabetes and drives early visual impairment. Multiple studies have verified that abnormal retinal neural responses frequently emerge before identifiable microvascular lesions. This review therefore systematically summarizes existing evidence confirming retinal neurodegeneration as a core, early pathological event in diabetic retinal disease (DRD), elaborates the cellular and metabolic mechanisms of neurodegeneration inside the retinal neurovascular unit (NVU), and assesses novel neuroprotective therapeutic modalities. Retinal neurodegeneration manifests prior to clinically apparent microvascular complications. NVU dysfunction, triggered by neuroinflammation, oxidative stress, advanced glycation end products (AGEs), excitotoxicity and mitochondrial dysfunction, serves as the pivotal pathway mediating neuronal injury. Notably, current vasculotropic therapies fail to effectively block early neuronal dysfunction. By comparison, neuroprotective interventions targeting oxidative stress, inflammatory cascades, glial dysfunction, deficient neurotrophic supply and mitochondrial damage exhibit promising effects on maintaining retinal neuronal architecture and function. In conclusion, retinal neurodegeneration constitutes a core pathological cascade of DR. Incorporating neuroprotective regimens into established treatment systems facilitates earlier intervention, optimizes visual function prognosis, and ultimately transforms the clinical management paradigm of DRD toward retinal neural protection.
authors: Wang CN, Xia YH, Huang H, Xu YX, Zhao DM, Dong JL, Ye HJ.
screening_reason: Focuses on retinal neurodegeneration driven by neuroinflammation and cellular stress in diabetic retinopathy.
summary_ja: 糖尿病網膜症（DR）における網膜神経変性が、微小血管病変に先行して生じる初期の核心的病理プロセスであることをまとめたレビューである。網膜神経血管ユニットの機能障害は、神経炎症、酸化ストレス、興奮毒性、ミトコンドリア障害などによって引き起こされる。酸化ストレスや炎症カスケード、グリア細胞障害を標的とした神経保護療法が、網膜神経の構造と機能を維持する新たな治療選択肢として注目されている。
summary_en: This review establishes retinal neurodegeneration as an early driver of visual dysfunction in diabetic retinopathy, occurring prior to clinically evident microvascular lesions. Neurovascular unit dysfunction is mediated by neuroinflammation, oxidative stress, advanced glycation end products, and mitochondrial impairment. Neuroprotective interventions targeting these pathways show promise in preserving retinal neural architecture and modifying current treatment paradigms.
key_finding_ja: 糖尿病網膜症において網膜神経変性は微小血管障害に先行する早期病変であり、神経炎症や酸化ストレスを標的とした神経保護療法の重要性が示された。
why_it_matters_ja: 従来の血管選択的治療に加え、神経保護アプローチを導入することで糖尿病網膜症の早期介入および予後改善に繋がる可能性がある。

title: Schisandrin A, a dietary lignan from Schisandra chinensis, ameliorates cognitive deficits in AlCl₃/D-galactose-treated mice.
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder with limited disease-modifying therapies. Chronic aluminum exposure, a well-recognized environmental risk factor, exacerbates AD pathogenesis by driving oxidative stress and neuroinflammation. Schisandrin A (SchA), a bioactive lignan from the medicinal and edible plant Schisandra chinensis, exhibits promising antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, yet its nutritional relevance for AD intervention remains undefined. This study evaluated SchA's neuroprotective potential in an AlCl₃/D-galactose-induced cognitive impairment model. We found that SchA significantly ameliorated learning and memory impairments in Morris water maze, novel object recognition, open field and Y-maze tests, alleviated neuronal damage in the hippocampus and cortex, and reduced cerebral amyloid-β (Aβ) production in AlCl₃/D-galactose-treated mice. Mechanistically, SchA mitigated neuroinflammation via inhibiting the IKK/NF-κB/iNOS pathway, and alleviated oxidative stress through activating the Nrf2/HO-1 axis. Our findings demonstrate that SchA exerts neuroprotective effects in AlCl₃/D-galactose-treated mice, accompanied by modulation of inflammatory and oxidative-stress-related signalling, supporting its potential as a nutritional intervention for AD.
authors: Xue JS, Niu M, Song XY, Deng XM.
screening_reason: Evaluates attenuation of neuroinflammation and oxidative stress by Schisandrin A in a mouse model of cognitive impairment.
summary_ja: 本研究では、塩化アルミニウムおよびD-ガラクトースにより誘導した認知機能障害マウスモデルを用いて、五味子由来の木質素化合物シザンドリンA（SchA）の神経保護効果を検証した。SchAの投与により、学習・記憶障害が有意に改善し、海馬および大脳皮質における神経細胞損傷とアミロイドβの産生が軽減した。作用機序として、SchAはIKK/NF-κB/iNOS経路を抑制することで神経炎症を抑え、Nrf2/HO-1軸を活性化することで酸化ストレスを緩和することが示された。これらの結果は、SchAが認知症に対する栄養学的介入の候補となり得ることを示している。
summary_en: This study evaluated the neuroprotective effects of Schisandrin A (SchA), a dietary lignan from Schisandra chinensis, in an AlCl3/D-galactose-induced mouse model of cognitive impairment. Treatment with SchA significantly improved learning and memory deficits, reduced hippocampal and cortical neuronal damage, and decreased cerebral amyloid-β production. Mechanistically, SchA attenuated neuroinflammation by inhibiting the IKK/NF-κB/iNOS pathway and reduced oxidative stress through activation of the Nrf2/HO-1 axis.
key_finding_ja: シザンドリンAは、IKK/NF-κB/iNOS経路の抑制とNrf2/HO-1軸の活性化を介して、モデルマウスの神経炎症と酸化ストレスを緩和し、認知機能を改善した。
why_it_matters_ja: 食事由来成分による神経炎症および酸化ストレスの制御可能性が示されたことで、アルツハイマー病に対する予防・介入アプローチの開発につながる可能性がある。

title: Management of Musculoskeletal Injuries with an Inflammatory Damage-Associated Molecular Pattern (DAMP) Etiology.
abstract: Introduction Musculoskeletal injuries (MSKI) often progress from acute tissue damage to chronic pain and dysfunction when mechanical overload and microdamage sustain sterile inflammation and neuroimmune sensitization. These processes amplify nociception, impair loading tolerance, and limit the efficacy of rehabilitation, underscoring the need for mechanism-based strategies that interrupt the transition from acute injury to chronic musculoskeletal disease. Methods This etiological review was conducted in accordance with the Scale for the Assessment of Narrative Review Articles (SANRA) guidelines. A comprehensive search of PubMed/MEDLINE and Google Scholar (1990-2026) identified mechanistic, translational, and therapeutic research reports that examined damage-associated molecular pattern (DAMP) signaling, innate immune activation, stromal cell responses, nociceptor sensitization, and interventions targeting these pathways. Eligible studies addressed DAMP-related mechanisms in musculoskeletal tissues or evaluated therapies that modulate the underlying inflammatory and mechanobiological drivers of chronic MSKI. Information was synthesized thematically to construct an integrated model of how DAMPs contribute to chronicity. Results Across tendon, cartilage, ligament, muscle, and fibrocartilage, mechanical overload and microdamage trigger the release of DAMPs that activate Toll-like receptors (TLRs), receptor for advanced glycation end-products (RAGE), and inflammasome pathways, thereby sustaining cytokine production, stromal cell activation, and nociceptor sensitization. Persistent DAMP signaling is strongly associated with impaired inflammation resolution, failed tissue healing, and progression to chronic tendinopathy, osteoarthritis, and mechanical low back pain. Emerging therapeutic approaches, including targeted loading, regenerative injections, metabolic modulation, and immune-modifying strategies, demonstrate potential to attenuate DAMP activity, promote resolution, and restore tissue homeostasis. Conclusions Sterile inflammation driven by DAMPs provides a unifying mechanistic framework explaining why many musculoskeletal injuries fail to resolve and instead evolve into chronic, refractory conditions. Therapies that modulate DAMP signaling, enhance inflammatory resolution, and normalize mechanobiological loading represent promising avenues for preventing or reversing chronic MSKI pathology. A mechanistically informed approach may improve clinical outcomes by addressing the etiological drivers rather than the downstream symptoms of chronic musculoskeletal disease.
authors: Love RJ, Sheridan J, Funk C, Young JL.
screening_reason: Reviews DAMP-driven neuroimmune sensitization, sterile inflammation, and nociceptor activation in chronic musculoskeletal injury.
